119040.note: The pin sits in the trees 30 m south of the drawn road, between it and a mown field with a fire ring 60 m south-east that is likely the group field; no lane from the road to either shows clearly.

231992.note: The pin sits in a large mown clearing with tracks across it, plainly the group field, and the drawn road ends at its east edge. The listing's own point is 683 m away, where nothing shows.

231994.note: The dense lidar (6.42 ground points per square meter) shows the pin on the gravel road at a sharp bend where a creek comes in, with only a small gravel pullout about 20 m across beside it; neither layer shows a levelled camping area, lane or clearing for a group camp within 150 m, and the photo shows only canopy. The listing's own point is 1.3 km away, outside the frame, so the camp can't be placed; nothing was traced or moved.

232216.note: The pin sits in a bare clearing in the woods, plainly the group site; traced the gravel lane from the end of the drawn spur into the clearing, which shows plainly.

232424.note: The pin sits on a mown clearing with a cabin, and the drawn lane ends in the clearing.

232437.note: Under the full canopy the lidar relief (6.49 ground points per square meter) plainly shows a cluster of a dozen levelled tent pads 10 to 60 m west and north of the pin, and the drawn Big Creek Group Camp spur from the campground loop road follows a graded lane between ditches to the pin at the cluster's east edge, within about 4 m of its middle. Nothing traced.

233108.note: The pin sits at the east edge of a large mown clearing with tracks across it, plainly the group field, and the drawn road ends at the pin. The listing's own point is 691 m away.

233109.note: The pin is on an unbroken wooded hillside with nothing at it. The Forest Service's point, 220 m southwest, is under canopy on a flat creek terrace beside the drawn Avery Creek lane, 30 to 50 m south of two small pale roofs; the ground relief shows the terrace as smooth and level, but no edges of a pad, loop or parking that plainly make it the group camp. Not moved.

233122.note: The pin sits beside a building in a small clearing on the drawn road, by the junction near the lake.

233139.note: The lidar layers confirm the drawn road 20 m east of the pin and show undrawn lanes farther east, but at the pin on the lakeshore slope they show no pad, building gap or clearing that is plainly the group camp, and the photo shows only bare autumn trees there. Nothing traced.

233164.note: The pin sits in a bare clearing in the woods, plainly a camp, but the drawn road runs 100 m east and no lane from it to the clearing shows clearly. The listing's own point is 310 m away.

233383.note: The pin sits beside the group shelter in a clearing, and the drawn lane ends at it. The listing's own point is 1.1 km away.

233497.note: The pin sits on the group shelter in the clearing by the beach, and the drawn road ends at the lot beside it.

233975.note: The pin sits by the lodge building in a clearing on the lake shore, and the drawn road passes beside it. The listing's own point is 4.5 km away, but the photo agrees with the unit's point.

233990.note: The lidar layers show only faint old tracks west of the pin and a light strip 60 to 100 m north that matches the photo's grassy gap; at the pin they show no pad, lane or building that is plainly the group camp, and no road is drawn in the frame. Nothing traced.

234051.note: The pin sits in the trees inside a drawn loop, 30 m from the parking lot; the canopy hides any pad, and the loops only partly follow lanes. The listing's own point is 1.9 km away.

234109.note: The pin sits in an open pasture on the drawn lane, by the barns and fields of the horse camp. The listing's own point is 317 m away.

234256.note: The pin sits by the cabin in its mown clearing, and the drawn lane loops up to it.

234258.note: The pin sits on the cabin building beside a parking area, and the drawn lane ends in the lot. The listing's own point is 5.6 km away, but the photo agrees with the unit's point.

234259.note: The pin sits by the cabin in its clearing, and the drawn lane ends at it.

234313.note: The pin sits under full canopy 75 m from the nearest drawn road; no clearing or cabin shows. The listing's own point is 2.5 km away.

234450.note: The 2020 lidar is thin here (1.63 ground points per square meter) but shows the end of Rhoda Branch Road plainly: it turns south-west about 60 m east of the pin, so the road drawn running west to a point 33 m south of the pin was on no band. Replaced the roads to follow the lane's band; the pin sits on the south-east edge of a raised flat terrace by the creek, about 55 m from the lane, and neither layer nor the photo plainly shows a camp or a lane to it.

234514.note: The pin sits on the group camp's building in a clearing, and the drawn loop passes 10 m north of it.

234516.note: The lidar layers show the paved parking loop south of the pin plainly, but the drawn loop cuts across its inside, and at the pin, 50 m north under the pines, they show level ground with no pad, lane or building that is plainly the group camp. Nothing traced.

234533.note: The pin sits on the pavilion in the open field by the lake; the drawn loop ends 25 m north, and a mown track toward it shows only faintly.

234584.note: The pin is on the wooded knob of the point 30 m east of the drawn road; the lidar relief (3.29 ground points per square meter) shows only forest floor and two drainage gullies there, with no levelled pad, building footprint or drive, and the photo shows only canopy. The drawn road west of the pin runs along the graded band's south ditch, 5 to 8 m off its middle, but with the cabin unplaced nothing was traced.

234585.note: The lidar relief (3.6 ground points per square meter) shows the drawn road through the point on its graded band, within about 4 m of its middle, 30 m south of the pin, but at the pin both layers show only a drainage gully and forest floor, with no levelled pad, building footprint or drive; the photo shows only canopy there, so the cabin can't be confirmed. Nothing traced.

234597.note: The pin sits beside the group site's building on the open lawn by the river; traced the gravel lane from the drawn road to it.

234599.note: The pin sits in the clearing between the group lodge and the cabins, and the drawn lane ends 20 m from it at the lodge.

234657.note: The pin sits on the cabin's roof in a clearing by the lake, and the drawn lane ends 25 m south of it.

234743.note: The dense lidar (7.29 ground points per square meter) shows the pin on an unbroken wooded slope inside the bend of the drawn road, which follows its band well; neither layer shows a levelled area, horse-trailer parking or a lane to the pin within 150 m, and the photo shows only canopy. The camp can't be placed, so nothing was traced or moved.

250024.note: The pin sits at the east edge of a bare clearing, and the drawn lane ends in it. The listing's own point is 512 m away.

251264.note: The pin sits on the big paved lot between the dorms, gym and dining hall of the camp, and the drawn roads run around it. The listing's own point is 3.6 km away, but the photo agrees with the unit's point.

251820.note: The pin, moved by canopy-16 onto the paved camping lot about 100 m north of the shore point, sits on it beside the picnic shelter and parked campers; the lidar intensity (1.41 ground points per square meter) shows the paved lot and its turnaround circle as smooth gray, and the drawn road runs down the lot's east side within it. The turnaround loop at the south end isn't drawn; nothing further was traced or moved.

251902.note: The pin sits in the open by the river, 10 m from the drawn road, beside a pull-off. The listing's own point is 1.9 km away.

251903.note: The pin sits on the drawn lane by its junction with the forest road, under pines; no clearing shows that is plainly the group site.

10145639.note: The lidar layers show the drawn forest road plainly under the pines, with the pin on it, and a lighter patch 30 to 60 m north-east that may be a clearing; the relief shows only a faint track looping east, not plainly a lane. No pad or clearing is plainly the group camp. Nothing traced.

10159068.note: The pin sits on the group lodge on the lake shore, and the drawn lane reaches it.

10182617.note: The pin sits in the bare clearing with the group shelter, and the drawn road crosses it.

10182619.note: The pin sits in scrub 20 m north of a bare clearing with the group shelter, which is plainly the unit, and the drawn road ends at the clearing's south edge. The pin itself is a little off.

10182621.note: The pin sits among the sun shelters of the group area on the open sand, beside the drawn park road.
